name: TG WS Proxy
description: WebSocket proxy for Telegram on Android. Bypasses DPI blocks by tunneling messenger traffic through WS/WSS protocol.

name: ByeByeDPI
description: Android client for DPI bypass. Uses TLS ClientHello desynchronization and packet splitting techniques. No root required.

name: Orbot (Tor)
description: Official Tor proxy for Android by Guardian Project. Routes traffic through volunteer network worldwide. Maximum anonymity.

name: v2rayNG
description: V2Ray client for Android. Supports VMess, VLESS, Shadowsocks, Trojan protocols. Popular open-source VPN solution.

name: DPI Tunnel
description: Android app for bypassing censorship without root. Local proxy with SNI spoofing and TLS desynchronization techniques.

name: Hiddify
description: Multi-protocol anti-censorship app. Supports Hysteria2, VLESS, VMess, Trojan, SSH with user-friendly interface.

name: PowerTunnel
description: Cross-platform anti-censorship proxy with plugin architecture. Available as desktop app and Android client.
